title: Taiwanese Association of Northwest Los Angeles 南加州 西北台灣同鄉會
content_html: The Taiwanese Association of Northwest Los Angeles (TANLA) is a regional chapter of the Taiwanese Association of America (TAA, 全美台灣同鄉會), the national umbrella organization for Taiwanese American community associations in the United States. TANLA serves the Taiwanese American community in the northwest Los Angeles area of California and is listed under the TAA Western region.
